text: DSH Model Audit 是面向 DSH Web 与桌面端的模型元数据监视插件。它挂接模型流并观察对应的 HTTP 请求与响应，不替换模型适配器。主要功能包括比较请求模型与响应声明模型、记录调用用途和会话标识、统计输入输出 token 与耗时，以及在本地仪表盘筛选和导出记录。适合希望核对模型路由结果的 DSH 用户。监控无需额外 API 密钥；记录仅保存在内存中。

DSH Model Audit monitors model calls in DSH Web and desktop. It compares requested and reported model names, records purpose, session, token counts and duration, and shows a local dashboard with filtering and JSON export. No extra API key is needed; records stay in memory.

DSH Model Audit 的功能「模型名称比对」：观察模型请求及响应中的模型标识，并给出匹配、不匹配或未知结果。请求流完成后记录比对状态。
DSH Model Audit 的功能「调用元数据记录」：按模型调用保存用途、会话标识、响应 ID、token 用量和耗时。插件提供有界的进程内记录快照。
DSH Model Audit 的功能「本地仪表盘」：从插件详情打开监控页面，查看和筛选调用记录，并自动刷新数据。
DSH Model Audit 的功能「记录导出」：在仪表盘点击导出，将当前内存快照下载为 JSON 文件。

An unofficial, independently built and installed plugin for DeepSeek Harness. It compares the actual outgoing request model with the upstream response model for DeepSeek Messages, GPT Responses and Chat Completions, in both the Web version and the desktop application.

@deepseek-ai/dsh-model-audit README · DSH Model Audit — independent local plugin：Not affiliated with or endorsed by DeepSeek. The `@deepseek-ai/dsh-model-audit` package ID is kept from the original local install for configuration migration; this package is not published to npm, and the name is local-only — do not publish it under DeepSeek's npm scope. Licensed under [MIT](LICENSE).

Install the directory or packed tarball with DSH's plugin manager, or:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add /absolute/path/to/dsh-model-audit --offline --ignore-scripts
```
section: DSH Model Audit — independent local plugin

text: @deepseek-ai/dsh-model-audit README · DSH Model Audit — independent local plugin：The desktop application owns its profile exclusively, so the CLI refuses `--profile desktop`; install there from the application's own plugin page (Installed plugins → add the absolute directory path) instead.
section: DSH Model Audit — independent local plugin

text: @deepseek-ai/dsh-model-audit README · DSH Model Audit — independent local plugin：The package appears under Installed plugins. After the first external-directory installation, restart DSH once so the host registers that linked package's peer resolution. A path change from an already loaded version also requires a restart. Then enable Model monitor, open its detail panel and select Open monitor; subsequent on/off switches work live. Records are held only in memory and are cleared on disable/restart.
section: DSH Model Audit — independent local plugin

text: @deepseek-ai/dsh-model-audit README · DSH Model Audit — independent local plugin：Open monitor behaves per surface: the Web version opens the dashboard in a new browser tab, while the desktop application renders it inside the application window, because that shell denies every popup on its own `dsh-app:` scheme. The desktop view fetches the same authenticated document and renders it in a same-origin frame; close it with the header button or Escape. Host-side plugin changes still need a desktop restart, because an already imported module stays cached for the life of that process.
section: DSH Model Audit — independent local plugin

text: @deepseek-ai/dsh-model-audit README · DSH Model Audit — independent local plugin：The package contains built host/browser artifacts. It does not edit the official repository, workspace, lockfile, built-in roster, or user credentials. All runtime framework imports use DSH's host-supplied peer dependencies. Plugin version 0.1.7-rc.2 targets and is tested against DSH 0.1.7-rc.2; future host API changes may require a plugin update.
section: DSH Model Audit — independent local plugin

text: @deepseek-ai/dsh-model-audit README · DSH Model Audit — independent local plugin：To upgrade from 0.1.7-rc.1, install the updated directory or deepseek-ai-dsh-model-audit-0.1.7-rc.2.tgz, then reload DSH so it reads the new package version and peers. This release passes the native compatibility check without a version exemption; 0.1.7-rc.1 stopped passing it because DSH 0.1.7-rc.2 split the Messages adapter config, and the plugin's bundled test fixture now loads `@deepseek-ai/dsh-llm-deepseek-api-key` for the API-key provider. Keep the older plugin package when using the older DSH release.
section: DSH Model Audit — independent local plugin

text:
@deepseek-ai/dsh-model-audit README · DSH Model Audit — independent local plugin：Only calls through `llm/stream` and global `fetch` are observed. WebSocket, private transports and replay are reported as unobserved. The dashboard retains model/response identifiers, usage, timing and call-purpose metadata, not prompts, completions or credentials. An upstream model-name declaration cannot attest model weights or compute allocation.

For development, link to a built, unmodified DSH checkout without modifying it:

text:
@deepseek-ai/dsh-model-audit README · Repository layout：- `src/` — host half (`index.ts`, `monitor.ts`, `parser.ts`, `dashboard.ts`, `locales.ts`) and browser half (`src/client/`).
- `lib/` — committed build output (`lib/index.js`, `lib/client.js` and their types) that DSH loads; `npm run build` regenerates it.
- `tests/` — monitor unit tests, a real Loader composition over the stock DeepSeek/GPT adapters, and a browser integration suite; `tests/expected/` holds their expected output.
- `scripts/link-dev.mjs` — links this plugin's development dependencies to an already-built DSH checkout without modifying it.
- `dist/` — untracked local `npm pack` artifacts.

@deepseek-ai/dsh-model-audit README · Repository layout：Supported host versions are exact: this release targets DSH `0.1.7-rc.2` and DSH refuses an incompatible plugin at load rather than risking a crash, so a newer DSH prerelease may need a matching plugin update. MIT license; the only third-party code inside the artifacts is `eventsource-parser`, and every framework import resolves to the host's own DSH packages at runtime.
